title: Third moment bound for affine transforms
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive with $\rho>0$, and suppose $\int X\,d\mu=0$ and $\int X^2\,d\mu=1$. Then, for all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, $\int |a+bX|^3\,d\mu\le \left(a^2+(b/\rho)^2\right)^{3/2}$.
